import hashlib,importlib.util,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd(); base=root/'evidence/mainline/engineering/07-environment'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('env_fresh_check',base/'run_fixtures.py')
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(module)
receipt=json.loads((base/'fixtures-5ca3c3a0/fresh-read-receipt.json').read_text())
passed={}
for name,row in receipt.items():
    if 'fresh_max_energy_residual_J' not in row: continue
    fresh=module.fresh_check(base/'fixtures-5ca3c3a0'/name)
    assert fresh==row, name+' changed after its accepted fresh read'
    passed[name]=fresh
assert len(passed)==9
cli=module.fresh_check(base/'cli-5ca3c3a0')
assert abs(cli['leaked_mass_kg']-.95)<1e-9 and cli['nuisance_inlet_mass_kg']==0
attempts=[json.loads(line) for line in (base/'fixtures-5ca3c3a0/engineering-attempts.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert len(attempts)==10 and sum(row['status']=='FRESH_READ_PASS' for row in attempts)==9 and sum(row['status']=='EXPECTED_DOMAIN_FAILURE' for row in attempts)==1
failure=receipt['minimum-inventory-domain']
assert failure['status']=='EXPECTED_DOMAIN_FAILURE' and failure['exception_type']=='ValueError'
from patrol_rsi.contracts import digest
saved_failure=json.loads((base/'fixtures-5ca3c3a0/minimum-inventory-domain-failure/scenario.json').read_text())
assert digest(saved_failure)==failure['scenario_sha256']
red=json.loads((base/'16-zero-drain-roundoff-red/root-floor-zero-drain-probe.json').read_text())
green=json.loads((base/'19-root-counterexamples-green/root-floor-zero-drain-probe-green-01.json').read_text())
assert red['probes']==108 and len(red['refused'])==49 and green['probes']==108 and not green['failures']
assert green['source_is_pre_acceptance_worktree'] is True
assert green['environment_sha256']==hashlib.sha256((root/'src/aegis_dc/environment.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
frozen={}
for name in ('configs/full-facility-mainline-v1.json','configs/full-facility-mainline-v2.json','configs/full-facility-mainline-water-v3.json','configs/materials/reference-r134a-saturation.json','src/aegis_dc/__main__.py','src/aegis_dc/scenario.py'):
    old=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','02423809d20fcd4541e8a16177f0e10371fb6f09:'+name],text=True).strip()
    actual=subprocess.check_output(['git','hash-object','--no-filters',name],text=True).strip()
    assert old==actual, name+' changed'
    frozen[name]={'unchanged_git_blob':actual,'sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
acceptance=json.loads((base/'acceptance-5ca3c3a0/summary.json').read_text())
assert acceptance['overall']=='PASS' and acceptance['tests']['run']==247 and acceptance['tests']['executed']==245
assert acceptance['tests']['failures']==acceptance['tests']['errors']==0 and len(acceptance['tests']['optional_neural_skips'])==2 and not acceptance['tests']['unexpected_skips']
checks={}
for directory in sorted(base.glob('[0-9][0-9]-*')):
    if directory.name.startswith('29-'): continue
    checks[directory.name]=json.loads((directory/'receipt.json').read_text())['exit_code']
failed=[name for name,code in checks.items() if code]
assert len(failed)==10, failed
files={path.relative_to(root).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in sorted(base.rglob('*')) if path.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in path.parts and not any(part.startswith('29-final') for part in path.parts)}
result={'schema':'aegisdc-environment-engineering-receipt-v1','classification':'FINITE_ENGINEERING_VERIFICATION_ONLY','implementation_commit':'ab6094bf','committed_run_source':'5ca3c3a03d05802458cef1bdd10e66928d75bc1b','source_tree_sha256':passed['normal']['source_tree_sha256'],'root_acceptance':'PENDING','mainline_status':'active','M1_status':'in_progress','frozen_inputs':frozen,'full_acceptance':{'discovered':247,'executed':245,'optional_neural_skips':2,'unexpected_skips':0,'failures':0,'errors':0,'original_files_valid':20},'checks_exit_code':checks,'original_engineering_failures_preserved':failed,'successful_fixture_count':9,'expected_domain_failure_count':1,'distinct_CLI_fixture_count':1,'root_zero_drain_probe':{'original':108,'original_refusals':49,'root_green':108,'root_green_failures':0,'root_green_label':'IN_PROGRESS_PRE_ACCEPTANCE_WORKTREE_DIAGNOSTIC'},'prior_engineering_files_sha256':files,'research_trials':0,'model_calls':0,'training_calls':0,'field_calibration':'PENDING','scientific_gain':'NOT_ESTABLISHED'}
with (base/'receipt-5ca3c3a0.json').open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as stream: stream.write(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'fresh_successful_runs':len(passed),'fresh_CLI_runs':1,'expected_domain_failures':1,'frozen_inputs':len(frozen),'prior_files_hashed':len(files),'preserved_failed_checks':failed,'full_acceptance':result['full_acceptance']},indent=2))
